name: Differentiable Transient Rendering with Implicit Geometry
definition: A forward pass step that computes time-resolved illumination 𝑯𝑅 at sensor points x𝑠 through transient rendering using implicit surface points x𝑔 and normals n𝑔.
summary: Differentiable Transient Rendering with Implicit Geometry computes time-resolved NLOS illumination by estimating surfaces from volumetric intensities to bypass binary visibility checks and enable gradient-based optimization.
